data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native editorial base photograph for a later restrained magazine headline
Primary request: Create a genuinely elegant, quietly absurd country-club powder room in which the exact Toilet Golf kit from Image 1 turns the floor in front of an ordinary white porcelain toilet into a tiny playable golf hole. It must feel like a witty interiors-magazine photograph first and a product scene second, never an ad.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole product-truth reference. The human and toilet show usage context only; do not reproduce the person. Preserve the actual included kit: one roughly 27-by-31-inch contoured low green printed fairway mat, one short mini putter with a black head and black grip plus a red shaft section, one or two ordinary white practice balls, and one small black round practice cup/base holding a short black pole with a red triangular flag, white circle, and simple black numeral 1. Do not invent clubs, holes, turf rugs, scoreboards, or other kit pieces.
Scene/backdrop: a refined but believable small powder room inspired by an old golf clubhouse: warm ivory plaster, dark green wainscoting, a simple white floor-mounted toilet at the left rear, warm terrazzo floor, one folded white hand towel on a small shelf. No golf branding, no words, no people.
Subject: the exact green mat lies flat on the floor directly in front of and extending away from the toilet, at its believable small real-world size. A white ball rests on the mat; the flagged black cup sits at the far end; the short putter leans naturally against the toilet side within reach. Every component must be physically grounded and clearly part of one small bathroom putting game.
Style/medium: highly realistic editorial interior photography, tactile materials, subtle 35mm film grain, dry British-club humor, not glossy commercial campaign polish.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3, three-quarter eye-level view from the doorway, toilet and complete kit in the lower two-thirds, generous naturally dark green wall in the upper third for later typography, asymmetrical magazine composition. The kit must be inspectable but not oversized.
Lighting/mood: soft morning window light with one warm wall sconce glow, sophisticated and deadpan.
Color palette: forest green, ivory, warm terrazzo, black, white, and one small red flag accent.
Text: no added words, captions, headlines, logos, badges, watermarks, pseudo-writing, or legible towel embroidery. Preserve only the simple numeral 1 already printed on the real red flag if it can be rendered cleanly.
Constraints: exactly one ordinary toilet and one complete small Toilet Golf kit; no person, exposed body, dropped clothing, package, CTA, price, border, collage, product card, fake UI, floating component, or implied included toilet.
Avoid: full-size golf course, giant mat, conventional standalone practice green, country-club logo, trophy, extra clubs, extra flags, malformed putter, folded or floating mat, game-show scale, product catalog staging, generic AI gloss.
notes: Generated from the exact Amazon source image and inspected at full useful resolution.
This is the selected contextual base for the deterministic headline treatment.
